articles.summary: American Airlines Group (NASDAQ: AAL) will webcast a live audio feed of its second-quarter 2026 financial results conference call July 23 at 7:30 a.m. CT.
articles.title: American Airlines Group announces webcast of second-quarter 2026 financial results

articles.summary: American Airlines Group Inc. (NASDAQ: AAL) today reported its second-quarter 2026 financial results, including record quarterly revenue, driven by strong demand for American’s product and solid commercial execution.
articles.title: American Airlines continues to execute on commercial priorities, delivering highest quarterly revenue in company history

articles.summary: Starting next spring, American will launch new nonstop service to Tokyo (NRT) from its hub in Chicago (ORD) in partnership with Japan Airlines.
articles.title: A new chapter for Chicago: American to launch nonstop service to Tokyo

articles.summary: American Airlines and Pittsburgh Institute of Aeronautics (PIA) announced a new partnership today to help prepare the next generation of aviation maintenance technicians (AMTs) and create a direct pathway for qualified graduates to pursue careers at American.
articles.title: Bridging rewarding careers in the City of Bridges: American and Pittsburgh Institute of Aeronautics announce partnership

articles.summary: American Airlines Group Inc. (NASDAQ: AAL) today announced that John W. Dietrich has been elected to the company’s board of directors. Dietrich will serve on the board’s Audit Committee and Finance Committee.
articles.title: American Airlines elects John W. Dietrich to its board of directors
